target: Teach another learner to reason about forgetting policies using a retention-and-deletion policy. Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.

competency.title: Teach forgetting policies — independent holdout
competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about forgetting policies using a retention-and-deletion policy. Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: keeping sensitive data in derived caches

competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in a retention-and-deletion policy.
competency.setting_constraint: Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include item-set hash, evaluator identity and aggregate verdict only.
Report correct deletion and downstream purge with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: keeping sensitive data in derived caches.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of forgetting policies.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report correct deletion and downstream purge against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for keeping sensitive data in derived caches; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
